## Support Fins panel, rearranged

- **Add as** (Part of the body or Separate body) now sits right under the part's name, so you choose how the fins are added before anything else.
- The Held and Support plastic cards, Suggest orientations, Strength and Load in use moved to a section at the bottom called **Print check**, together with Material and Bare beyond. It starts open, and you can fold it away like the others.
- Draw Walls has the same order.
- The small line under Support plastic no longer gets cut off.
